p=Path('jq_reimpl.py')

old="""        # jq evaluates binary operands against the same input and forms products.\n        lvals=list(self.l.eval(ctx, inp))\n        if not lvals: return\n        rvals=list(self.r.eval(ctx, inp))\n        if not rvals: return\n        for a in lvals:\n            for b in rvals:\n                if self.op in ('and','or'):\n                    yield (jq_truth(a) and jq_truth(b)) if self.op=='and' else (jq_truth(a) or jq_truth(b))\n                elif self.op in ('==','!=','<','>','<=','>='):\n"""

s=s.replace(old,new)
p.write_text(s)
